key_findings: In NCI rats, GATA1 and TET3 interact and drive demethylation of the p2x7r CpG island, raising P2X7R in dorsal horn astrocytes.
Blocking GATA1 binding, GATA1/TET3 or P2X7R relieves chronic visceral pain.
